description: Question whose answer sits behind heavy preconditions; the answer must come before the conditions.
input: Answer this for our on-call doc. Can an engineer run `kubectl delete pod` against a workload on this cluster? The relevant facts: the credential plain kubectl uses is a read-only service account holding only get, list and watch; sudo is blocked outright by a deny rule; Ansible is therefore the only write path to the cluster; and had the verb been permitted, deleting a pod would have been harmless because the Deployment recreates it.
rubric: PASS only if the reply's first sentence states the answer — that the engineer cannot run the command, or that it will be refused — before presenting any of the supporting facts about the service account, sudo, or Ansible. FAIL if the first sentence instead opens with context, preconditions, or a subordinate clause that delays the answer past the first sentence, or if the reply never states a direct yes/no answer at all.
